decision: Do not infer envelope airtightness from ventilation type. Use identical leakage table for each topology. Retain legacy era/state relative ratios provisionally, scaled to .20 L/s/m² for older existing MF.
basis: Prior MF SE.02 F fitted .20 Core ACH implies .157–.274 L/s/m² across known volume/Atemp ratios. This motivates a central .20 engineering start, not national validation. Later eras/states retain prior relative ratios; not separately calibrated.

references.sveby: https://www.sveby.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Sveby-brukarindata-bostadshus-2.0-241111.pdf, chapters 5–6: ventilation .35 and separate airing; no infiltration table
references.tabula: https://episcope.eu/fileadmin/tabula/public/docs/report/TABULA_CommonCalculationMethod.pdf, equation 7/table4: retained legacy source-height representation only

compatibility_ach_formula: q_l_s_m2 * 3.6 / 2.5; NEVER apply this source ACH to Core model volume without conversion
pressure_coupling: Exhaust/wind/stack pressure coupling unresolved; effective additional leakage assumption, not pressure-network simulation
validation: Completed retrospective Gothenburg MF SE.02 existing/F/district heat validation: baseline 54/85 within 20%, no final fitted overrides, provisional. Independent/national and other era/state/system validation pending.
profile_warning: Previous ACH-based fitted profiles are superseded for Data 1.5. The current Gothenburg MF SE.02 area-rate profile (cohort_profiles/2026-10-05-v2) selects baseline with no overrides and remains provisional.
